row.notes: Takes an AABB (min/max float4 at +0x10/+0x20), clears a pointer table (+0x110, count +0x130), then for each of N objects (+0x128) chooses the split axis (flags bit0-2 at +0x12c, -1.0 sentinel), counts per-axis totals (+0x60..0x68) and builds quantisation scale/bias masks (+0x30/+0x40/+0x70). Hypothesis: sweep grid for the physics world. Callers Ne_PhysWorld_InitFromConfig (2 sites).
